name: La fantastica storia di Don Chisciotte della Mancia
original_name: La fantastica storia di Don Chisciotte della Mancia
overview: The Mad Adventures of Don Quixote of La Mancha, a knight-errant of sad countenance, devoted to protecting the weak and fighting injustice alongside his faithful squire Sancho Panza, in a five-part series that brings together the staging, actors, audience, musicians, and “behind-the-scenes” elements, blending documentary and fiction.
